elements.name: Inspect project information from the template chooser

elements.name: Inspect an inactive project without activating it

the Projects dialog closes
the chooser still displays the original active project

elements.name: Inspect and cancels the new single-user project wizard

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/WizardProject.opj` as its first project
the user opens the Projects dialog from the template chooser with `WizardProject` active
the wizard fixture has no entries in either library list
the user chooses New
the new-project wizard opens on a project-type page
New Single User Project is selected
the Next and cancels controls are available
the user chooses Next
the wizard displays a project name, workspace folder and project file to be created
it provides a folder browsing control
the user chooses Next
the wizard displays a Select Libraries page
the page has All Projects and New Project lists with transfer controls
both library lists are empty
a provisional project entry is visible in the project list behind the wizard
the user chooses Cancel
the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed
the provisional project entry is no longer listed
the original project remains marked active

elements.name: Expand and collapse project settings with the keyboard

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/ActiveProject.opj` as its first project
the user opens the Projects dialog from the template chooser with `ActiveProject` active
`ActiveProject` displays collapsed Folder Options and Options groups
the user selects the collapsed Folder Options group
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the group expands to show folder entries including Templates, Design Data and Presets
the user presses the Left Arrow key
the Folder Options children are hidden
the user selects the collapsed Options group
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the group expands to show project options including old versions to keep and unique file names
the active project remains marked in the project list

elements.name: Expand library groups independently in the project tree

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/ActiveProject.opj` as its first project
the user opens the Projects dialog from the template chooser and selects `ActiveProject`
`ActiveProject` has collapsed Appearance Libraries and Material Libraries groups with entries
the user selects Appearance Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key
the appearance library entries are visible beneath their group
the user selects Material Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key
the material library entries are visible beneath their group
the appearance library entries remain visible
the user presses the Left Arrow key
the material library entries are hidden
the appearance library entries remain visible
the active project remains marked in the project list
